_about: Phase 5 scorecard (5 items), pre-registered 2026-11-22 with the criteria, before any memory code existed. Each item passes only if its criterion passes in mdqc.verify_phase5.

S1_memory_store_correct.means: saving, reading, editing, deleting and exporting memory work exactly, and survive a data reload

S2_remembers_across_sessions.means: each new session starts with exactly what the investigation has stored, nothing more or less

S3_deletion_is_real.means: deleted memory is gone from every table; no hidden copy, the audit trail stores no text

S4_guardrails_hold.means: invented evidence and personal data are refused; every save is confirmed to the user

S5_export_and_ci.means: the export shows everything stored; tests run in CI on a real database
